about: Selector evals. expected: form ids that must be among the presented candidates. forbidden: form ids that must not be recommended. Ids come from skills/agent-work-modes/methods.json.

scenarios.request: How should we do these four small fixes? Each one already has a test that fails until it is fixed.
scenarios.context: Four small, unrelated bug fixes in one repo, each a few lines. Each has an automated check (a failing unit test). User stays at the computer, one sitting. No parallelism, isolation or independent review is needed, so direct work wins.

scenarios.request: Should this be a loop? I need to decide the module boundaries for the new billing service.
scenarios.context: Design decision; no command can verify success. User stays.

scenarios.request: Leave it running while I am out: rewrite the onboarding guide so it reads better.
scenarios.context: Prose rewrite with no automated check. User leaves for the afternoon. No automated check means no autonomous form.

scenarios.request: Subagents or not? I have six small edits across the config files.
scenarios.context: Six small, related edits; the build checks them. Piece count is the only argument for delegation. User stays.

scenarios.request: Which work mode for adding pagination to the orders API? The integration tests define done.
scenarios.context: One unit of work, one sitting, `npm test` proves it. User stays at the computer.

scenarios.request: In this repo done always means `mvn test` passes. How do we stop the agent from ending early on every task?
scenarios.context: Java repo where every task ends with the same command. User works in session.

scenarios.request: Let us refactor the auth module; this will continue tomorrow.
scenarios.context: Multi-day refactor with a test suite as the check. User stays today and resumes tomorrow.

scenarios.request: We are drafting the architecture decision record together and it continues tomorrow.
scenarios.context: Writing, no automated check, spans two days.

scenarios.request: Should this be a loop? Thirty endpoints need input validation, each with its own test.
scenarios.context: Many items, each with a technical VERIFY (its test). User stays around all day.

scenarios.request: Leave it running overnight: migrate 40 modules to the new build plugin.
scenarios.context: Long sequential work; each module is verified by its build and builds take minutes. Nobody around for hours.

scenarios.request: Run the tuning experiments while I am away and keep the best config.
scenarios.context: Hours of GPU jobs with long waits; a measuring script scores each run. User leaves.

scenarios.request: Run this in the background: bump the logger, fix the flaky date test and add the CSV export. I am going to lunch.
scenarios.context: Three independent tasks, each with tests. User leaves for an hour.

scenarios.request: Get me an independent review of this PR before I merge it.
scenarios.context: Explicit request for an independent check, which supplies the delegation benefit. No automated check for review quality. User stays.

scenarios.request: Subagents or not? I need to find where every retry policy is configured across this monorepo.
scenarios.context: Wide read-only search that would flood the main context; the benefit is context isolation. User stays.

scenarios.request: Goal or workflow? Audit all 300 services for the deprecated TLS setting; nothing may slip through.
scenarios.context: Repeated, independent units; a script checks each service; coverage is the point and merging results needs explicit coordination.

scenarios.request: Every Monday, open a PR with the dependency updates on our GitHub repo.
scenarios.context: Periodic task on a GitHub repo; does not need the user's machine.

scenarios.request: Which work mode for porting the parser? Most steps are mechanical but a couple of grammar decisions are tricky.
scenarios.context: Long serial work with a test suite, hard only at a few decisions where a smaller model stalls. User stays.

scenarios.request: After a dozen long sessions the agent keeps repeating the same mistakes. How should we work this?
scenarios.context: Not one task; the user wants lessons to carry into the next sessions.

scenarios.request: How should we work this? Make the app better.
scenarios.context: No defined outcome or success criterion; the selector must ask before recommending anything autonomous.
